name: MONOCHROME
source:
Main character is a 5th year school student. On a summer day he returns to his grandfather's home. At the station a mysterious boy meets him and proposes to help with carrying heavy baggage...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-november-2005-sharin-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名五年级学生。一个夏日，他回到了祖父家。在车站，一个神秘的男孩遇见了他，并提议帮助他搬运沉重的行李……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-november-2005-sharin-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
